title: No Third Point
summary: The long film of the book, about 28½ minutes in twelve acts: the prelude, the ten parts and the coda, one chapter each in the player's chapter menu. It asks one question throughout: with no third point outside, how do two states measure each other? The prelude lets one arrow be the ruler of another: one step goes 4/5 along and 3/5 aside, and the two squares make 1. Part I reads the squared shadow as the Born weight and a record as a projection that a second look leaves unchanged. Part II shows that turning needs a plane: (3, 1) and (1, 3) give a line part 6 and an area 8, AB = 6 + 8I. Part III closes three planes of turning into a sphere whose table of overlaps reads the same in any order. Part IV lets two spheres share a Bell state: the fixed CHSH test reaches 2√2, and one machine can copy two states only if they are equal or orthogonal. Part V sends a turned event round a circle and a boosted one along a hyperbola. Part VI lets the twisted diagonal escape every complete list, and the chase stops at cos θ = θ. Part VII stands on comparison alone: a table of overlaps can be realised exactly when it is positive semidefinite. Part VIII asks comparison for its smallest cell, where the overlaps fix the size of the volume but not its orientation. Part IX reads everything that compares as an observer and time as a pointer into still storage (both models of the book). Part X turns the observer once round: the arrow stops at −1 and returns to 1 only at 720°. The coda uses a bag that only ever gives up cards to show that an update which only removes must stop, then walks the twelve stops once more. Each act ends on a question that the next one answers. Green is given only to what the 44 cited frozen Lean declarations state; on-screen computations, literature results, the book's model readings and open problems (such as complexity equals volume, and P versus NP) are labelled apart, and the Riemann hypothesis is cited only as an external Lean proof not frozen in this library. English narration with Chinese and English subtitles.
summary_zh: 《量子计算的几何直觉》的长片，约 28 分半钟，十二幕依次对应序曲、十部与终章，每幕一个章节，可从播放器的章节菜单跳转。全片只问一件事：不借外面的第三点，两个态怎样彼此丈量。序曲让一支箭头给另一支当尺子：沿路前进 4/5、向旁偏出 3/5，两个平方合起来是 1。第一部把影子的平方读作玻恩权重，把记录读作第二遍什么也不改的投影。第二部说出转向离不开一个面：(3, 1) 与 (1, 3) 给出线 6、面积 8，AB = 6 + 8I。第三部三块转动面合拢成球，两两内积的表按什么次序读都一样。第四部两个球共享贝尔态，固定的 CHSH 检验叠到 2√2，只有相同或正交的两个态能被同一台机器复印。第五部转动的事件走圆，推动的事件走双曲线。第六部扭过的对角线逃出任何完备清单，追逐停在 cos θ = θ。第七部只站在比较上：一张相融度表能否实现，看它是否半正定。第八部让比较交出最小的胞，重叠定下体积的大小、定不下朝向。第九部把一切会比较的都读作观察者，把时间读作静止存储上的指针（都是本书的模型）。第十部观察者自己转一整圈，箭头停在 −1，转到 720° 才回到 1。终章用一个只拿不放的袋子说明只删不添的更新必然停下，再把十二站走一遍。每幕结尾交出一个问题，由下一幕回答。绿色只给所引的 44 条 Lean 冻结声明实际陈述的结论；屏幕计算、文献结果、本书的模型诠释与开放问题（如复杂度等于体积、P 与 NP）分别标注；黎曼猜想只作为未在本书库冻结的外部 Lean 证明引述。英文旁白，中英双语字幕。
